restaurant_name: Sure Smile Dental Clinic คลินิกทันตกรรมชัวร์สไมล์ แยกเสนานิคม
text:
I've used their services about 5-6 times because I got braces here (choosing the wrong place changed my life!). I think there were only 1-2 times that I felt okay; the rest were never impressive. From the staff and some doctors who aren't thorough, to the fact that you can charge whatever price you want for scaling – we don't know if your price is fair or overpriced – but since the patient is paying, they should feel that the work is worth the money. It takes less than 5 minutes to do, but when I got home and looked in the mirror, there was still tartar on some teeth, as if the doctor hadn't even looked at that area. Another tooth was scaled, but not all of it was removed because the doctor wasn't thorough at all; they were in a hurry.
Once, the staff forgot to schedule my appointment. I waited at the clinic and wasted a lot of time. And of course, I couldn't get the treatment because the doctor said they had another appointment and couldn't take my case. The staff's management was terrible.
The service was also sometimes rude.
I've waited a long time almost every time I've gone. If there's a long wait, please call to inform me beforehand. Don't wait until I arrive at the clinic to be told that I have to wait about an hour. If you called beforehand, I wouldn't have wasted my time. That day, I chose to reschedule because I couldn't wait and had other appointments. Also, a staff member gave me the wrong orthodontic rubber bands. This caused us to have to extend our orthodontic treatment, and we didn't receive an apology from this staff member either.
I was unimpressed with everything here. Don't come here, everyone. I really don't recommend it. ❌❌ Go somewhere else that offers better quality and service. The one star I gave was for the lovely doctor.

restaurant_name: Sure Smile Dental Clinic คลินิกทันตกรรมชัวร์สไมล์ แยกเสนานิคม
text:
I got my braces done here.
The doctor is lovely, and the clinic is clean, but...
The staff member who usually calls to remind you of appointments... They used to call regularly, but one month they didn't call at all, and I even forgot. When I asked when I went, the staff member showed me the computer screen and said the number was wrong. I was very confused. How were they able to call in the previous months?
The assistants, besides the male and the tall female one, are all very heavy-handed. It hurt a lot. They pressed my tongue so hard I almost vomited. I told the doctor, but they just told me to endure it.
Regarding the brackets coming loose, they came loose frequently, 3-4 brackets a month for several months. It turned out the brackets were rubbing against my teeth. The doctor only reduced the price after the last checkup where the brackets were hitting my teeth.
According to the terms and conditions, you can miss 3 months of treatment. In short, for those 3 months I missed, I still had to pay for the braces. I'm very confused. For example, if I paid for 30 months (I don't remember the exact number), in the 31st month I have to continue treatment. If I miss month 31 and go in month 32, I don't have to pay, but I still have to pay for things along the way. It's very confusing.
I paid almost 50,000 baht in total for braces, adjustments, and adjustments.
That's it. I'm done. I won't go back, and I wouldn't recommend it to anyone. I chose this clinic initially because it was close to my workplace.
